title: Shinkolobwe uranium mine
summary: Shinkolobwe, a mine of Union Minière in the Belgian Congo about 100 miles northwest of Lubumbashi, held some of the richest uranium ore known. In 1940 Edgar Sengier shipped about 1,200 tons to New York; the United States bought it in 1942 for the Manhattan Project. The mine officially closed in 2004.

uncertainty.note: The start is the 1940 ore shipment to the United States, not the mine's opening, which the opened pages do not date. End is the official closure in 2004.
